create_CLIPProcessor: create a CLIPProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal image-text input
load_CLIPProcessor_from_pretrained: load a pretrained CLIPProcessor from a local path or HuggingFace model identifier
save_CLIPProcessor_to_directory: save a CLIPProcessor instance to a local directory for reuse in downstream tasks
call_CLIPProcessor_on_images_and_text: call a CLIPProcessor to tokenize text and preprocess images for CLIP model input
push_CLIPProcessor_to_hub: push a CLIPProcessor configuration and files to a HuggingFace Hub repository
